$comment: Presets. A mode overrides the keys it lists; everything else comes from defaults/user/project config. Select with mode in config or /crew --eco | --normal | --strict

eco.description: Cheapest. Lead thinks on Sonnet, workers on Haiku, one review round. Use when quota is nearly gone or the task is small.

normal.description: Balanced default. Lead on the strongest model, coding on Sonnet, reading/writing on Haiku, up to 3 review rounds.

strict.description: Highest assurance. Strongest models everywhere that matters, two independent reviewers must both pass, up to 4 rounds. Use for auth, payments, data migrations.
